evidence: Upper has no identified color or shape and is essentially unattended; its accessability is very low and stays low over the next two steps.
Right is a red triangle with low attention and modest recoverability that falls over one and two steps.
Lower is a yellow circle with very low attention and modest-but-smaller recoverability that also falls.
Left is a blue cross, which I am attending almost exclusively now and which is the most recoverable at the moment; its recoverability nevertheless declines over subsequent steps.
Commands in A predict that issuing an attend command for any location will move my next selection to that commanded location, so I can direct selection to any of the four locations.
Upper is a blue cross with low current attention and moderate recoverability.
Right is a red triangle that I am attending almost exclusively now but is not the most recoverable.
Lower is a green square and is the most recoverable now despite low attention.
Left is a yellow circle with low attention and intermediate recoverability.
In B, all commands predict my next selection will go to upper, so I cannot reliably redirect selection to other locations.
recoverability predictions decline across the one- and two-step horizons regardless of selection.
